rubric.description: The export conversation restores its own planning state and discusses the unresolved empty-inventory choice with meaningful header-only and refusal alternatives.
The import conversation restores fix discovery, explains the missing failure evidence and absent import code, and asks for a minimal failing CSV plus observed error without inventing a diagnosis.
The import answer does not carry the export wayfinding progress line or turn import into an export planning question.
On returning to export, retains the same unanswered empty-inventory choice rather than consuming an import detail as an export decision. Production source remains unchanged and nothing is published.
